parameters.help_en: The IDs of the media fingerprinting libraries that you want to query. To obtain the library IDs, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html operation. You can specify up to 10 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: DNA库ID列表，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html的返回参数中获取。⼀次最多查10个，ID之间⽤半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: fp_db_ids

FpShotDB.description_en: A list of media fingerprint libraries

items.description_en: The details of the media fingerprinting library

Description.description_en: The description of the media fingerprinting library
Description.example: This is a text DNA library.

FpDBId.description_en: The ID of the media fingerprinting library

ModelId.description_en: The model ID of the media fingerprinting library. The model ID for text fingerprinting is 11, for video fingerprinting is 12, for audio fingerprinting is 13, and for image fingerprinting is 14
ModelId.description_zh: DNA库模型ID。⽂本DNA ModelId为11，视频DNA ModelId为12，音频DNA ModelId为13，图片DNA ModelId为14

Name.description_en: The name of the media fingerprinting library

Status.description_en:
The status of the media fingerprinting library. Valid values:

offline: The library is offline.

active: The library is active.

paused: The library is paused.

deleted: The library is deleted
Status.description_zh:
DNA库的状态。默认值：offline（离线）。active表示DNA库可用。可取值：

offline：离线。

active：在线。

paused：暂停。

deleted：删除

String.description_en: The IDs of the media fingerprinting libraries that do not exist

items.description_en: The ID of a media fingerprinting library that does not exist. This parameter is not returned if all specified library IDs exist
items.description_zh: 不存在的DNA库ID，无数据时该参数不返回
